meta.title: ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill: refused for a user without the Warehouse Executive role
gaps: Select or verify a tenant on the Enterprise plan without a named QA company ID
Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Executive role
Open and execute ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill from a linked ASN
Repeat the action as a Warehouse Executive
Compare the refused or absent action with the Warehouse Executive's available and prefilled GRN form
Record whether tenant RBAC intentionally grants the capability to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select or verify a tenant on the Enterprise plan without a named QA company ID; Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Executive role; Open and execute ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill from a linked ASN; Repeat the action as a Warehouse Executive; Compare the refused or absent action with the Warehouse Executive's available and prefilled GRN form; Record whether tenant RBAC intentionally grants the capability to additional roles

args.need: Use the Enterprise tenant, sign in as a user without the Warehouse Executive role, attempt ASN-to-GRN Auto-Prefill from a linked ASN, then repeat as a Warehouse Executive and compare whether the action is refused or absent versus whether the GRN form is prefilled.

steps.note: The required ASN/GRN workflow and role-specific sessions are not available in the catalog.
Assert that the resulting session remains free of application errors after the tester completes the role comparison.
